python3 - << 'PY'
# Net options positions from Table FCP-VI-1 (in millions of euros)
pre_pandemic = {
    '01/08/20': -342,
    '01/15/20': 323,
    '01/22/20': -329,
    '01/29/20': -290,
    '02/05/20': -444,
}

post_pandemic = {
    '03/18/20': -24,
    '03/25/20': -100,
    '04/01/20': -67,
    '04/08/20': -125,
    '04/15/20': -197,
}

# WHO declared COVID-19 a pandemic on March 11, 2020 (report date 03/11/20)
# 5 weeks PRECEDING (excluding the pandemic week 03/11/20):
# 01/08, 01/15, 01/22, 01/29, 02/05 (weeks before)
# 5 weeks FOLLOWING (excluding the pandemic week 03/11/20):
# 03/18, 03/25, 04/01, 04/08, 04/15 (weeks after)

pre_values = list(pre_pandemic.values())
post_values = list(post_pandemic.values())

print(f"Pre-pandemic net options positions (5 weeks before, excluding 03/11): {pre_values}")
print(f"Post-pandemic net options positions (5 weeks after, excluding 03/11): {post_values}")

cum_pre = sum(pre_values)
cum_post = sum(post_values)

print(f"\nCumulative pre-pandemic: {cum_pre}")
print(f"Cumulative post-pandemic: {cum_post}")

# Absolute difference: pre - post (in the order written: "preceding and following")
diff = cum_pre - cum_post
abs_diff = abs(diff)
print(f"\nDifference (preceding minus following): {diff}")
print(f"Absolute difference: {abs_diff}")

# The question asks: "absolute difference in cumulative net options Euro positions
# over the 5 weeks preceding and the 5 weeks following"
# This means |cumulative_before - cumulative_after|
print(f"\nFinal answer: {abs_diff}")
PY
